look_here_first: INTRODUCED fern grass: small annual making stiff, narrow, often one-sided ANGULAR flowering branches that resemble a tiny green fern. Spikelets clustered close to the branches are flattened and multi-flowered. On a fresh stem, examine the 3-angled panicle axis, short stalks, and true membranous ligule before naming it.
